raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Sean is trying to play the 'nice guy' now that he successfully robbed Ziv and bought a development card. parsed.internal_thinking: Sean is trying to play the 'nice guy' now that he successfully robbed Ziv and bought a development card. He moved the robber off my Wheat 9 to Ziv's Ore 5, which helps me but mostly hurts Ziv. He's trying to frame it as a favor to me to break the alliance. I should acknowledge the move but keep the focus on his lead and the fact that he just stole what he couldn't trade for.
